text: This report recommends the appointment of a Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to CreateTO. Confidential Attachment 1, which provides information on the recommended candidate, will be provided at the Board meeting.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Appointed the candidate identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 2, 2021) from the Board Chair, CreateTO to the position of Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO as recommended by the Selection Committee, once the recommendation is ratified by City Council, and subject to an agreement of employment terms. 2. Authorized the public release of the name and candidate summary of the individual identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 2, 2021) from the Board Chair, CreateTO, once the recommendation is ratified by City Council and employment terms are agreed, and direct that the remainder of Confidential Attachment 1 remain confidential as it contains personal information about an identifiable individual. 3.
